Distinguish between cold lime-soda process and hot lime-soda process.

Calculate the amount of lime (92% pure) and soda (98% pure) required for treatment of 30,000 litres of water whose analysis is as follows : $\text{Ca(HCO}_3)_2 = 40.5 \text{ ppm}, \text{Mg(HCO}_3)_2 = 36.5 \text{ ppm}, \text{MgSO}_4 = 30.0 \text{ ppm}, \text{CaSO}_4 = 34.0 \text{ ppm}, \text{CaCl}_2 = 27.75 \text{ ppm}, \text{NaCl} = 10.0 \text{ ppm}$.
Explain the types of hardness of water.

Calculate the osmotic pressure of a solution obtained by mixing $100 \text{ ml}$ of 4.5% solution of urea (mol. mass = 60) and $100 \text{ ml}$ of 3.42% solution of cane sugar (mol. mass = 342) at $300 \text{ K}$. (Given $R = 0.0821 \text{ L atm K}^{-1} \text{ mol}^{-1}$)
What is molal elevation constant? What are its units?
What are isotonic, hypertonic and hypotonic solutions? What happens when such solutions are separated by a semipermeable membrane?
Write down the electrodes, electrolytes and the cell reactions involved in dry cell or Leclanche cell.

Write in Nernst equation and calculate the e.m.f. of the following cell at $298 \text{ K}$ : $\text{Cu(s)} | \text{Cu}^{2+} (0.130 \text{ M}) || \text{Ag}^{+} (1.0 \times 10^{-4} \text{ M}) | \text{Ag(s)}$ Given $E^\circ_{\text{Ag}^{+}/\text{Ag}} = 0.80 \text{ V}, E^\circ_{\text{Cu}^{2+}/\text{Cu}} = 0.34 \text{ V}$.
Describe the working of simple galvanic cell.
What is a fuel? How are fuels commonly classified?

What is the significance of volatile matter in coal?

Distinguish between addition and condensation polymerisation.
